_README: PROJECT-AGNOSTIC TEMPLATE. Copy to cluster_<job>.json and fill in the <…> fields. This is the ONLY per-job file in the package. The drawing PDF is supplied at runtime (--pdf / INGEST_PDF) and is NEVER stored here.
setId: <SETID, e.g. PROJECT-PHASE — namespaces sheetIds + subjects; never a real project name in tracked files>
_grainLevel: bid = hard-bid / precon (coarser, trade-package level) | ca = awarded / construction admin (finer, toward per-location). Tunes instance grouping in the decompose read. See $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scope-harness/reference/read-grain.md.
_lenses: "all" = every lens in $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scope-harness/trade-lenses.json | or a list of lens keys to restrict the fan-out.
_packet: tiling is REQUIRED for schedule-bearing sheets; targetTilePx≈2800 keeps every tile legible regardless of sheet size.
_trades: the trade lenses to fan out — keys MUST exist in trade-lenses.json. Today the corpus is 7 interior lenses; add lenses (data, not code) to cover more scope.
_titleKeywords: case-insensitive title substrings to select sheets; [] = whole set. WARNING: generic words like SCHEDULE/FINISH over-select across disciplines (they grab electrical/plumbing/structural schedules) — constrain the actual read with v0Subset.
_v0Subset: explicit sheet numbers to render + read (the bounded set passed to build_reading_packet --only). This is what actually scopes the run; titleKeywords is just the discovery net.
